facets.description: utilities.js line 182 (validateUploadedFile): the client-side size check is hardcoded to 10MB for every upload type and ignores max_attachment_size_kb (and other per-type settings) for non-images, so the file_too_large message there shows 10MB
utilities.js line 246 (413 handler): the file_too_large message shows a hardcoded 10MB instead of the limit that is actually enforced
